verdict.rationale: Attio's Workflows platform explicitly includes a 'Routing Agent' that 'routes every lead to the right rep or channel' and a 'Scoring Agent' that assigns fit based on ICP criteria, directly supporting automated lead assignment; workflows can also trigger on new record creation. However, evidence is all vendor marketing copy with no configuration detail on round-robin logic, tie-breaking, or capacity balancing, and no independent/hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of round-robin/assignment rule configuration options, independent or hands-on validation of the Routing Agent in practice, and evidence of load-balancing or fairness logic.
